summary: Access Tempo time-tracking data via MCP. Use when the user asks about Tempo worklogs, plans, teams, accounts, or wants to log time, check resource allocations, or manage timesheet approvals. Triggers on phrases like "log my time in Tempo", "how many hours did I log this week", "check my team's worklogs", "what's the resource plan for this sprint", or any request involving Jira/Tempo time tracking. Requires tempo-api-mcp installed and the tempo server registered (see Setup below).
